results.debugger_script:
set pagination off
set confirm off
set debuginfod enabled off
set auto-load off
set startup-with-shell off
set disable-randomization off
python
import gdb, json
gdb.Breakpoint('/dev/shm/hepta-c7c6ee414a6c/tmp/hepta-debug-qualification-5qj0o475/debug-rust.hepta-debug/78fa70846e274268af3f122746d381402bd2ffbc306d7d64d2590c175b1e31a4/program.rs:12')
gdb.execute('run')
f = gdb.selected_frame()
s = f.find_sal()
values = {name: int(gdb.parse_and_eval(name)) for name in ['h_input', 'h_base', 'h_result']}
if values != {'h_input': 7, 'h_base': 12, 'h_result': 36}: raise gdb.GdbError('unexpected live locals: ' + json.dumps(values))
frames = []
walk = f
while walk is not None:
    frames.append(walk.name())
    walk = walk.older()
if len(frames) < 2: raise gdb.GdbError('missing caller frame')
observation = {'file': s.symtab.fullname(), 'line': s.line, 'locals': values, 'frames': frames}
gdb.execute('next')
after = gdb.selected_frame().find_sal()
observation['step_file'] = after.symtab.fullname()
observation['step_line'] = after.line
print('HEPTA_DEBUG=' + json.dumps(observation, sort_keys=True))
gdb.execute('continue')
end
